To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the WSAT tool is able to verify the correctness of web services and that the WSAT is a useful tool to help web service developers.
the model checking approach is applicable to web services and that the model checking techniques can help us to verify the properties of web services.
(1) the WSAT tool is a model checking tool for web service composition, (2) it is based on the model checker SPIN and (3) it supports XML data and XPath expressions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
1) how to formally represent web services, 2) how to verify the correctness of web service designs, and 3) how to support the verification process with an effective tool.
developing a formal framework for analyzing web service compositions, and implementing a tool to support such analysis.
the development of a tool to analyze and verify composite web service designs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current state of the art in model checking is insufficient for analyzing web service compositions.
model checking techniques can not be applied directly to web services, and a lot of work is required to make them applicable to web services.
the current state of the art in model checking does not support the formal analysis of web service composition, even for the most basic properties such as deadlock-freeness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WSAT is the first tool for formal analysis of web services.
we have developed a model checking framework for analyzing web service designs.
we developed a tool for verifying web service composition designs, which can be applied to the most common web service composition languages, such as BPEL, XLANG and WSFL.
The main takeaway from our work is that
model checking can be applied to web service verification, and that a model checker for web services must be able to deal with asynchronous messaging, XML data and expressive XML based manipulation.
the state of the-art model checking tools are not suitable for analyzing web service composition.
, by using a combination of state of the art techniques, we can provide a tool that supports the formal analysis of composite web services.
